properties.Name_of_Tank: Construct a tank at Ambalammana School to store spring water
properties.Remarks: No storage tank at the source and needs a pipeline. Recommend 1. To construct ferro cement 4m (diameter) x3m (high) tank. (35m3) 2. Form a CBO to operate and manage. 3. Install a 63mm Dia pipe line with 18mm lateral pipes for houses. 50% of pipe network cost has to be obtained as community contribution.
Water leakages from the tank and the insufficient capacity of the tank. Recommend constructing 4m diameter x3 m high ferro cement tank (35 m3) with 25% contribution from the community. (325,000)
